meta.name: firebase-data-connect
meta.description: Builds and deploys Firebase SQL Connect (aka Firebase Data Connect) backends with PostgreSQL securely. Use when designing schemas with tables and relations, writing authorized queries and mutations, configuring real-time data updates, or generating type-safe SDKs. Use when you need a relational database with Firebase, or when the user mentions SQL Connect or Data Connect.

copy.tagline: 用 PostgreSQL 构建并部署 Firebase 数据后端
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在用 Firebase 并需要关系型数据库和类型安全 SDK
copy.tagline_en: Build and deploy Firebase SQL backends with PostgreSQL
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Firebase and need a relational database with type-safe SDKs

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 能搭建并部署基于 PostgreSQL 的 Firebase SQL Connect 后端:设计表与关系、编写带权限的查询和变更、配置实时更新,并生成多平台的类型安全 SDK。
howto.when: 当用户提到 SQL Connect 或 Data Connect,或要求设计表结构、编写授权查询、配置实时更新等时触发。

say.text: 给 movies 查询加排序和分页,并设为仅登录用户可访问。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can build and deploy Firebase SQL Connect backends on PostgreSQL: define tables and relations, write authorized queries and mutations, configure real-time updates, and generate type-safe SDKs for multiple platforms.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions SQL Connect or Data Connect, or asks for designing table schema, writing authorized queries, configuring real-time updates, etc.

say_en.text: Help me design a users table in schema.gql with id, email, and a posts relationship.
say_en.note: Claude will generate the schema type using @table syntax.

say_en.text: Add sorting and pagination to the movies query, and restrict it to logged-in users.
say_en.note: Claude will add orderBy/limit and @auth in queries.gql.

say_en.text: Run dataconnect:compile to validate, then deploy to Cloud SQL.
say_en.note: Claude will compile first, then run deploy --only dataconnect.
